answer: By the delta of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, unlocked only after continuous uptime, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The dune lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the canyon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
